svg.aria-label: Where each model pays, measured in D5 on the presenter's Mac after the three dashboards were proven identical, relative only, ranges over the measured runs. Redo per order, the order included: embedded about 17 KB, counter documents about 5 KB, converged about 3.5 KB. Dashboard read for one region: embedded about 0.6 ms, the counter pipeline 0.6 to 0.7 ms, converged about 0.4 ms. The same counts at the same speed: the difference is where the query lives
